content.text: Tumor of the proximal convoluted renal tubule cells (they are very metabolically active cells so they are the most prone to dysplasia)
95% of primary tumors originating in the kidney
Characterized by lack of warning signs, variable presentations, & resistance to chemo/radiation
Tumors blocks left testicular vein drainage ⇢
MC seen in children within first 5yrs of life
▪︎MC renal malignancy in children (MC abdominal mass in children)
▪︎recurrent or multiple lesions can be treated w/
hard, indurated, nodular, enlarged, asymmetrical prostate
If PSA >10 ⇢ order bone scan to r/o METS
